item.text: [{"task_id":"05f2a901~v","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    moving = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    target = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    spacing = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    row_axis = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    col_axis = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    result = grid.copy()","    if row_axis != 0 or col_axis != 1:","        return result","    mobile = np.argwhere(grid == moving)","    anchor = np.argwhere(grid == target)","    if len(mobile) == 0 or len(anchor) == 0:","        return result","    mobile_low = np.min(mobile, axis=0)","    mobile_high = np.max(mobile, axis=0)","    anchor_low = np.min(anchor, axis=0)","    anchor_high = np.max(anchor, axis=0)","    row_gap = max(anchor_low[row_axis] - mobile_high[row_axis], mobile_low[row_axis] - anchor_high[row_axis])","    col_gap = max(anchor_low[col_axis] - mobile_high[col_axis], mobile_low[col_axis] - anchor_high[col_axis])","    axis = row_axis if row_gap > col_gap else col_axis","    if mobile_high[axis] < anchor_low[axis]:","        shift = anchor_low[axis] - mobile_high[axis] - spacing","    elif anchor_high[axis] < mobile_low[axis]:","        shift = anchor_high[axis] - mobile_low[axis] + spacing","    else:","        return result","    result[grid == moving] = background","    for point in mobile:","        destination = point.copy()","        destination[axis] += shift","        row = int(destination[row_axis])","        col = int(destination[col_axis])","        if 0 <= row < grid.shape[row_axis] and 0 <= col < grid.shape[col_axis]:","            result[row, col] = moving","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[6]},"params":{"rule":[0,6,2,1,0,1]},"rationale":"Translate the magenta shape toward the red square along their separating axis until their bounding boxes are adjacent, preserving its shape and the square. The tensors encode background, object colors, adjacency spacing, and coordinate axes."}]
